title: SEO Site Profile
description: Site facts for one site (data only — selects and prioritises, never invents metrics). Classification (query categories incl. brand, page tags, page languages, channels incl. AI assistants, tracked keywords) lives in seo/config/rules/<domain>.json (seo/rules.py); `x-derived-from-rules` keys are computed from it by seo/site_profile.py. Consumed by skills via {{site:<key>}} tokens.

markets.description: Target markets (ISO country codes, or the sentinel WORLDWIDE)

ads_customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID used for Keyword Planner calls

ads_language_constants.description: Language code -> Keyword Planner language resource. Verify with GAQL: SELECT language_constant.id, language_constant.code FROM language_constant

ads_geo_targets.description: Keyword Planner geo targets (max 10); empty = all locations (use for WORLDWIDE)

serp_locations.description: Language code -> DataForSEO location_code for live SERP checks. Unset = ask the user which market to sample.

thresholds.description: Per-site overrides of seo/gsc_metrics.py DEFAULTS (see domain-knowledge.md for meaning).

x-derived-from-rules.languages: page language codes (rules page_languages: default first)
x-derived-from-rules.sections: page tags (rules page_tags) plus the default tag
x-derived-from-rules.services: service categories (rules query categories except Brand/Generic, in category_caps order)
x-derived-from-rules.priority_keywords: Core tracked keywords grouped by language code
